opportunities.title: Small Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals unless they can provide organisational backing.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for projects that bring together the UK and Japan in arts, culture, humanities, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport, with typical awards of £1,500‑£5,000.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally have an existing research record, but practitioners, managers, carers and others in health‑related fields are also eligible. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards of up to £10,000 (maximum £30,000 over three years) to support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in the UK and Japan.
